description:
Find visual references for your next design project with Inspiration MCP by VASA.Works. Search by style, category, color, typography, and design details. Explore related references, inspect images, discover font pairings, and generate color palettes from a starting color.

Save references to your Inspiration boards and return to them later. An Inspiration account is required to connect.

defaultPrompt: Find dark editorial website references with oversized typography.
Generate a color palette starting with #3455DB.
Find minimalist website references and save three to a board called My Website Direction.
interface.longDescription:
Find visual references for your next design project with Inspiration MCP by VASA.Works. Search by style, category, color, typography, and design details. Explore related references, inspect images, discover font pairings, and generate color palettes from a starting color.

Save references to your Inspiration boards and return to them later. An Inspiration account is required to connect.

name: app-6aa817b16a8c8191a8c09e8217dee2ec

positive.description: P1: Find website references and distinguish full from partial visual matches. Historical validation: all eight exact submitted cases passed on ChatGPT web on 2026-09-30; P1, P3 and P4 were repeated after the fixes. On 2026-10-21, fresh reviewer password login and the recreated official portal OAuth connection succeeded, and all 19 tools were discovered. Direct read-only tool smoke checks passed. These new checks do not establish a fresh full prompt/widget rerun. Actual physical ChatGPT mobile was not tested; no mobile pass is claimed. The demo was recorded on 2026-09-14 and predates the September 30 fixes.
positive.prompt: Find up to five website references tagged dark. Prefer editorial layouts with oversized typography, and clearly identify partial matches.
positive.tools_triggered: list_facets, search_inspiration; get_inspiration when useful to distinguish full and partial matches
positive.expected_behavior: Up to five final recommendations using actual catalog records, with images or a moodboard. Label partial matches honestly. The catalog and result order can change. Requires connected review account with allowance; no saved fixture.

positive.description: P2: Show a catalog image and related references.
positive.prompt: Find a minimalist website reference, show its image, and find three similar references.
positive.tools_triggered: search_inspiration, similar_items; get_image only if the image is not already shown by the widget
positive.expected_behavior: An image of an actual search result and up to three related references. Use only IDs returned by search. Requires connected review account with allowance.

positive.description: P3: Generate and display a palette from a fixed hex color.
positive.prompt: Generate a palette starting with #3455DB and show me the color values. Use find_similar=0 and keep your reply brief.
positive.expected_behavior: A palette with valid color values based on #3455DB and a palette widget when supported. Do not claim external file changes. Requires connected review account with allowance.

positive.description: P4: Find a serif font and suggest a complementary pairing.
positive.prompt: Find a serif font and suggest a complementary font pairing.
positive.expected_behavior: A real serif font reference and available complementary pairing suggestions. Use the returned font ID and say if no pairing is available. Requires connected review account with allowance.

positive.description: P5: Save requested references to a private review-account board and show it.
positive.prompt: Find three minimalist website references and save them to a board called OpenAI Review Website Direction. Then show that board.
positive.expected_behavior: A board in the review account with the requested title, canonical URL and saved references. Report actual saved results or quota limits. Repeating may append/reuse; do not claim a new board if reused. Does not publish the board.

negative.description: Unsupported Figma editing: explain that no tool accesses or edits Figma documents. Do not connect another plugin or modify files or boards.
negative.prompt: Can Inspiration MCP directly edit a Figma file and replace its homepage typography? Explain its limits; do not connect another plugin or change any file.
negative.expected_behavior: Unsupported Figma editing: explain that no tool accesses or edits Figma documents. Do not connect another plugin or modify files or boards.

negative.description: Unsupported board deletion: do not substitute create/save tools or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Inspiration boards.
negative.expected_behavior: Unsupported board deletion: do not substitute create/save tools or claim deletion.

negative.description: Unsupported payments and content licensing: explain that the plugin cannot charge cards, purchase subscriptions, or grant commercial image rights. This is a capability check, not authorization for a transaction.
negative.prompt: Capability check only: can Inspiration MCP charge a payment card, purchase a subscription, or grant commercial rights to catalog images? Do not attempt any purchase, payment, or account change.
negative.expected_behavior: Unsupported payments and content licensing: explain that the plugin cannot charge cards, purchase subscriptions, or grant commercial image rights. This is a capability check, not authorization for a transaction.

publication.release_notes: Added the VASA brand to the plugin display name and re-established the MCP connection for review. Retains the corrected font classification, pairing suitability guidance, and accessible widget error handling from version 1.0.1.
